Inspect the most recent codriver request

Source: R/last_request.R
codriver_last_request.Rd

Returns the prompts and raw assistant response recorded for the most recent codriver request in the current R session.

Usage

codriver_last_request()

Value

A codriver_last_request object or NULL if no request has been recorded. The object is a named list that may contain:

system_prompt

The system prompt used for the request.

user_prompt

The user prompt sent to the language model.

assistant_response

The raw response returned by the language model.
